brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a new illustration. Wide landscape 16:9 canvas, ideally 1600 x 900 or 1792 x 1008, at least 1000 pixels wide. All lettering is part of the finished art.

ART DIRECTION: Match the approved black-and-lime editorial reference shown earlier: deep charcoal #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory type, bold Japanese heavy sans-serif headline, energetic hand-cut ink shapes and dry-brush strokes. Clearly a hand-drawn sports illustration, never photographic or a photo collage. Keep the design very clean, powerful and readable at thumbnail size.

TEXT — render ONLY the following exact Japanese/Latin strings, correctly spelled and crisp:
Top small masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
Date beneath it: 「2026.11.13」
Large headline: 「試合結果」
Second large headline in lime: 「当日のEFF」
Smaller explanatory line, clearly legible: 「リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3」
Bottom footer in ivory, clearly readable: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Next to that footer: 「イメージ」
Do not render Japanese quote brackets. No other wording, numbers, player names, statistical values, scores, labels, watermarks, jerseys numbers or signatures.

LAYOUT: Put the dynamic athlete predominantly on the LEFT 43% and the type on the RIGHT 53%, a different composition from the earlier approved sample. Keep 4–5% safe margins around all lettering, the athlete's head, the orange basketball and both hands. A strong lime brush sweep curves diagonally behind the player. Position masthead/date at upper right, the two main headlines stacked centrally on right, explanatory line below. Leave a clean dark strip across the bottom for the two mandatory labels. Illustrate head through upper thighs, with the knees intentionally outside the composition below the crop, so face and both arms are spacious and anatomy clear. Do not let the athlete or brush strokes interfere with the text.

REAL PERSON — only one player, Atomu Yamada (山田安斗夢), as seen in the official Kumamoto Volters profile photo inspected in this conversation. The photograph is a likeness reference ONLY; redraw him from scratch with ink. He is a Japanese adult man, compact athletic muscular shoulders and arms, medium-light warm skin, clean-shaven, defined oval face with moderately broad cheekbones, tapered but substantial jaw, small rounded chin, straight dark eyebrows, almond-shaped brown eyes, medium straight nose, fairly full lips. His short dark brown-black hair has a loose off-center part with forehead exposed, textured wavy lifted top, shorter neat sides and slightly pointed sideburns. Retain these recognizable facial features in an expressive but believable illustration, with a concentrated neutral playing expression and the face clearly visible in three-quarter view. No beard, no long hair, no headband. Draw a simple unbranded dark basketball jersey with ivory panels and restrained red trim, no team/league/sponsor logos or writing anywhere. Monochrome ivory/charcoal ink hatching on body and clothing with restrained warm skin accents; orange ball as the only warm bright accent.

ACTION: Atomu Yamada leaning forward in a powerful low dribble drive, body angled toward the viewer and right, his right hand on the upper surface of the basketball at hip height, left arm bent naturally protecting space. Two arms and two anatomically correct hands, five fingers per hand with natural occlusion; clear connected shoulders, wrists and fingers. Ball fully inside the frame. Make the pose energetic and balanced without adding an opponent or any other person.

EDITORIAL SCOPE: This article is a multi-game results roundup dated 2026-11-13 with that day's official EFF rankings by league and position. The player was RANDOMLY selected from names in the fixed manuscript, not the article's unique star. Therefore do NOT show his name, performance, score, rank, jersey number or claims about his participation or success. Do not portray this as an actual identifiable game moment, match winning shot, exact venue, or reconstruction of a real photograph. This is a generic imagined playing pose featuring the real player's likeness. The labels 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」 are mandatory. No logos, official photographs, courtside ads, scoreboards, extra players, or unsupported facts. Do not carry over any name, date, score or statistic from the approved style reference.

ONE PERMITTED CORRECTION:
Edit the first reference image (the generated black-and-lime basketball thumbnail) with a targeted correction. The second reference image is Atomu Yamada's official profile photo; use it ONLY to redraw his likeness as ink illustration, never paste any photo pixels or official/sponsor/team marks.

Preserve the 16:9 landscape canvas, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B palette, energetic brushwork, orange ball, and ALL existing Japanese wording exactly:
バスケまとめ
2026.11.13
試合結果
当日のEFF
リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
Keep every label and headline fully legible, with no new text.

Make exactly these linked corrections to the illustrated player:
1. Replace the overgrown wavy hair with the OFFICIAL PHOTO hairstyle: SHORT dark hair, neat short sides, a loose side/off-center part with exposed forehead, lightly textured lifted top. Shorter and much less fluffy than the current illustration. Match the actual face in reference two: smoother narrower eyebrows, gently rounded oval face, moderately broad cheeks, narrower almond eyes, relatively straight nose, full relaxed lips, compact rounded chin. Completely CLEAN SHAVEN, remove the dark moustache and chin-stubble appearance. Keep a focused expression in 3/4 view. Anatomically athletic but not exaggerated bodybuilder arms. Keep hand-drawn ivory/charcoal ink rendering, not a photograph.
2. Scale and shift the illustrated player/ball group slightly inward so the entire head, BOTH HANDS, and the ENTIRE BALL have generous clear margins (at least about 40 pixels) from the left and top edges. The player can still be cropped intentionally at upper thighs at the bottom edge. Keep the low driving dribble pose and correct connected arms/wrists with five natural fingers per hand. Do not obstruct the right-hand typography.
3. Keep plain unbranded uniform. No logos, numbers, name, statistics, claims about the randomly selected player's performance, or other people. This is a generic action IMAGINATION, not a recreation of an actual game.
Output exactly one finished corrected PNG, at least 1000 px wide.

qa_observations.likeness_or_no_named_person: 公式写真と比較し、髪の長さ・分け目・輪郭・目鼻・口元・ひげなしを反映した山田安斗夢選手のイラストを確認。実在人物を使用し、画像内には選手名なし。
qa_observations.layout: 頭部・両手・ボールの見切れなし。手指と腕の接続を目視確認。文字と人物の重なりなし。下端は意図的な太ももトリミング。約16:9。
